observations: Upright chest-style freezer with top lid open in photo 0; interior shows ice/frost and a drain/cover area.
Branding sticker visible on front door in photo 1: “Haire” and “THERMOCOOL” (also a “5 years warranty” style badge).
Photo 2 shows the rear/side with condenser/coil area and a visible wire/guard; there is dust/possible wear around the base and on the unit.
No clear model number or exact capacity (liters) is readable from the photos provided.

claims.claim: Classic and reliable themocool freezer with a string capacity long lasting freezing for up to five...
claims.evidence: Photos show ThermoCool branding (photo 1) but do not show the exact capacity or the meaning/limit of “up to five” (likely years/warranty or hours) in a readable way.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year.
claims.evidence: No purchase date/receipt is shown in the photos.

claims.claim: No fault at all, the motor was never opened.
claims.evidence: Photos do not confirm motor condition or whether it has been opened.
No receipt or warranty card is shown.

risks.risk: Capacity/model mismatch: the exact ThermoCool model and liters are not readable, which affects market price.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the rating plate/model label (usually on the back or side) showing model number and capacity (liters).
risks.if_unproven: Price as a generic ThermoCool upright freezer of unknown capacity (worst-case for value).

risks.risk: Cooling performance not proven: frost/ice in photo 0 could be normal, but the freezer may not hold temperature or may have weak cooling.
risks.proof: Video of it running with a thermometer reading inside (and/or a temperature log) after 30–60 minutes.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not fully proven (assume needs testing; worst-case treated as not guaranteed working).

risks.risk: Electrical/starting issues: compressor/motor health can’t be confirmed from photos.
risks.proof: A short clip showing the compressor start and stable operation (no unusual noise/smell) plus power consumption reading if available.

risks.risk: Condition/wear: visible dust and possible wear around the base/coil area (photo 2) could indicate poor maintenance or age beyond “barely used.”
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the base, coil area, and any rust/leaks; plus a photo of the interior drain area.
risks.if_unproven: Price as used with maintenance needs (worst-case).

risks.risk: Lid seal/gasket condition: poor sealing reduces freezing efficiency and increases power use.
risks.proof: Photo/clip of the lid gasket around the full perimeter and a simple seal test (paper strip test).

proof_requests: Clear photo of the rating plate/model label showing model number and capacity (liters).
Video showing the freezer running (compressor on) and a thermometer reading inside after it stabilizes (30–60 minutes).
Photos of the warranty card and receipt (showing date of purchase).
Close-up of the lid gasket and drain area; confirm no leaks/major rust.
A short clip of the rear/coil area while running (to confirm no abnormal noise/overheating).
response.reason: The photos confirm it is a ThermoCool freezer, but the exact model/capacity and working performance are not verifiable remotely. Hidden risks (cooling strength, compressor health, seal condition, and model mismatch) directly affect the price, so proof is needed before pricing.
